Move time is the total distance divided by the selected speed. Naismith-style baseline uses 5 km/h plus 10 minutes per 100 m cumulative climb. Custom mode uses the speed and climb you enter. Scheduled delays are added separately.

Snakes and Ladders is played in many locations with different board art, jump locations and final rules. This page uses the original board art and a list of configurable overshoot rules; do not treat it as the only local or official version. This game uses a simple computer opponent, not a network match. No account required and no moves uploaded.
